title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender marinated chicken in a rich, aromatic tomato-cream sauce with warming spices. One of the world's most popular curry dishes.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka masala spice blend for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Grill or broil marinated chicken until slightly charred, about 10 minutes.
Melt ghee in a large pan. Sauté onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 minutes. Add garam masala, cumin, and turmeric.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes until sauce thickens.
Stir in cream and grilled chicken. Simmer 10 more minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan.
author: Chef Priya
